methods.preflight: preflight(target, snapshot, action) -> void; throw STALE_SNAPSHOT/TARGET_MISMATCH/OCCLUDED/BLOCKED_PERMISSION/BLOCKED_SESSION before effect
methods.execute: execute(target, snapshot, action, {markAttempt,verifyResource}) -> {action_state,effect_state}; call markAttempt(binding) exactly before potentially mutating native action, never retry uncertain effects
methods.close: close() -> disconnect only; do not close foreign pages/windows

elements: Array<{role,name,bounds_px:[x,y,w,h],source,confidence,locator?}>; refs assigned only by core as snapshot_id:eN
state: Deterministic bounded JSON for hash; include target geometry and controls, omit timestamps/cursors/secrets/network payloads
snapshotCaptureFailure: UNKNOWN_EFFECT after attempt; never fabricate next snapshot
images: Scoped target full/crop/none. Opt-in Web region capture has explicit CSS image geometry; unchanged image reuse retains matching region/geometry/hash. Pixel delta is not implemented.
denialRule: No different backend to bypass denial for the same target/scope

region.rect: [integer x,integer y,positive integer width,positive integer height], wholly inside content viewport; no clamping

regionCapture.geometryGuard: visualViewport scale1 and zero offsets; exact viewport/DPR/scroll before and after capture
regionCapture.stepRegion: persisted snapshot region, identical freshness and after capture
regionCapture.containment: Every coordinate-space result and concrete semantic action center within half-open ROI
regionCapture.privacy: Whole original viewport/tree secret scan; secret outside ROI suppresses all pixels
regionCapture.beforeEffect: Actual bound PNG/ref/hash/image_geometry mandatory; never and invalid after image mode reject before attempt
regionCapture.legacyFullMode: Existing full capture/hash/coordinates and old full snapshots preserved
